latestUpdate.description: V6.1 Market Microstructure Completion — inventory market making (Garman flow, Stoll three-component spread decomposition, Ho-Stoll optimal quote skew), information and toxicity (Easley-O'Hara PIN likelihood, VPIN order-flow toxicity), the limit order book (make-or-take decisions, queue value and fill probability, zero-intelligence LOB simulation, Hawkes self-exciting intensity), cost measurement and price discovery (quoted/effective/realized spread and impact identity, Corwin-Schultz and Roll low-frequency proxies, Lee-Ready misclassification, square-root impact law, Hasbrouck information shares and Gonzalo-Granger weights), and market design and resilience (tick size, call auction vs continuous trading, circuit breakers, dark pool diversion, liquidity evaporation half-life, Amihud-Mendelson liquidity premium) — 17 interactive panels plus a nine-part Microstructure reading guide. V6.0 Macroeconomics Completion — endogenous growth engines (AK / Lucas / Romer / Schumpeter vs Solow), growth and development accounting, Samuelson multiplier-accelerator cycles with state-dependent fiscal multipliers (slack, ZLB, Ricardian offset), RBC calibration against business-cycle facts, Calvo pricing and NKPC micro-foundations, rules vs discretion (Barro-Gordon inflation bias plus Taylor / inflation / price-level / NGDP targeting), parity conditions and carry (PPP, UIP, CIP and the Fama forward-premium puzzle), sudden stops and external adjustment, expectation formation (rational / adaptive / sticky / diagnostic with CG coefficients), unconventional policy (QE portfolio rebalancing and YCC), bank capital and deleveraging spirals, and climate transition macro paths — 12 new labs plus a nine-part Macroeconomics reading guide. Previously V5.8 Risk Management Completion — coherence axioms with spectral/distortion measures and elicitability scoring, EWMA/GARCH/HAR volatility with filtered historical simulation, PD/LGD/EAD and the Basel IRB capital formula, rating migration and CreditMetrics credit VaR, funding liquidity and margin spirals with survival horizons, the Basel capital stack with LCR/NSFR compliance checks, model risk with epsilon-contamination robustness, and multi-period capital trajectories for recovery planning — 23 risk tools plus a new Risk Management reading guide. Previously V5.7 Derivatives Completion — state prices and super/sub-replication bounds, Longstaff-Schwartz American/Bermudan pricing with exercise boundaries, futures vs forwards and convenience yield, SVI surface fitting with butterfly/calendar arbitrage checks and Dupire inversion, Vasicek/CIR/Hull-White plus the HJM drift condition and Black-76 caplets, reduced-form hazard bootstrapping and CDS par spreads, Carr-Madan Fourier pricing against variance-reduced Monte Carlo, and rough volatility (rBergomi) with mean-variance / utility-indifference hedging — 25 derivatives tools. Previously V5.6 Portfolio Completion — frontier geometry & two-fund separation (CAL, tangency, zero-beta CAPM), Sharpe single-index reduction, estimation error vs the 1/N benchmark, constraints & rebalancing cost, the fundamental law of active management with Treynor-Black, downside risk & stochastic dominance, Merton dynamic allocation with glide paths, and high-dimensional regularisation with maximum diversification — 19 allocation tools plus a new Portfolio Theory reading guide.
